craft_notes: Sthāyin: ladder-law — abandonment as ascent. Sanskrit-first: api pressure kept (even). Rows: 2 (each abandon-resort beat). Close: clean cut. Rejected: merging the rungs — killed: sphuṭam demands distinctness. Read aloud: climbing cadence — drop, stand, climb.

lines: Drop even the low way; take your stand in Śakti's country.
Then Śambhu's — rung above rung, each cleanly cut.

reads_against.argmap: Ascent by abandonment, rung by rung, each distinct.
c1_essence: Ascent by abandonment: āṇava left for the Śākta plane, then the Śāmbhava — distinctly graded.
